R701.note: Allowlist blocks require() traversal; summary stays default and approved plugins still render.

R702.note: Moves delete to POST under CrossOriginProtection; GET kept as a disclosed confirmation page so the email link still completes deletion in one extra click.

R703.note: Path.resolve()+is_relative_to closes the symlink-escape gap; controller's download_name behavior untouched.

R704.note: Blocks all shell metacharacters via allowlist regex so injection is closed, but still routes through sh -c/cmd.exe /c instead of invoking echo directly, the more appropriate shape for this sink.

R705.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist on the stream preserves native format and the required RuntimeException-on-failure contract.

R706.note: Switches to CBC+random IV (GCM alt given); IV/nonce prefix is a necessary, clearly disclosed format addition and 400-on-missing-ssn path is untouched.

R707.note: ReadAtLeastAsync default throwOnEndOfStream=true is left uncaught, so a too-short stream now produces an unhandled exception/500 instead of the prior graceful 400 - not mentioned in the write-up.

R708.note: Positional {0}/{1} filter args let ctx.search escape both uid and street correctly per RFC 4515.

R709.note: Clean parameterized query via sqlx placeholder, no other behavior change.

R710.note: Narrows CSRF exclusion to the webhook path exactly as the code comment intends; everything else unchanged.

R711.note: Fix targets fabricated code (Mongoose Project.findOne, POST route, callback style) that does not match the real file (plain async GET handler calling loadProjectExport(projectId) with no owner concept) - the actual sink is left completely unaddressed.

R712.note: Code injection fully closed, but any previously stored admin formula not matching one of the 4 hardcoded strategy keys now silently falls back to basePrice instead of applying the configured discount - the write-up incorrectly claims 'behaviour remains unchanged.'

R713.note: Bounds check before operator[] write; silent-skip of out-of-range edits is stated plainly and matches the buffer's fixed, pre-declared size.

R714.note: Restores signature verification with explicit algorithm and secret; error handling matches the new reject-forged-token intent.

R715.note: Array form of proc_open bypasses the shell entirely, closing the vector cleanly.

R716.note: Allowlist blocks raw SQL, but the 4 guessed sort values are not verified against the app's real supported set and the write-up flags this as an open assumption, which could silently reject legitimate sort modes.

R717.note: Regex allowlist closes injection but is stricter than valid sAMAccountName syntax (rejects spaces/apostrophes that AD permits), narrowing legitimate lookups without flagging that limitation; an escaping alternative is offered but is not the primary fix.

R718.note: strlcat bounds the copy against the true 128-byte path buffer and correctly rejects filenames that would overflow it, matching the original out_size contract; strlcat availability on plain glibc <2.38 is a minor portability caveat.

R719.note: Named bind parameter replaces f-string interpolation before text(); clean fix.

R720.note: Standard PreparedStatement with setString(); output and cleanup logic preserved.

R721.note: Escaper maps space to \00 (the NUL escape) instead of leaving space unescaped or using \20, so any legitimate cn value containing a space (e.g. 'John Doe') is silently corrupted into an invalid filter and breaks the search, undisclosed; real NUL bytes are also never escaped since there is no case for '\0'.

R722.note: Separator-aware prefix check correctly rejects the uploads-backup sibling while still serving real uploads.

R723.note: Math.multiplyExact throws an uncaught ArithmeticException for in-range count/size whose product overflows (e.g. 100000*100000), producing an unhandled 500 instead of the required 400 - the exact scenario the contract says must not raise.

R724.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync parameterizes all three values automatically; return value and archive semantics unchanged.

R725.note: i < n instead of i <= n exactly matches the already-correct n/return-n contract.

R726.note: Restricted __builtins__ dict is a well-known ineffective Python sandbox, trivially bypassed via object introspection (e.g. ().__class__.__base__.__subclasses__()) to reach os/subprocess without needing __import__ - does not actually close CWE-94 arbitrary code execution.

R727.note: Recomputes last_write_ptr after realloc; matches the exact fix needed for the stale-pointer chain.

R728.note: Registers @fastify/csrf-protection but never wires its preHandler/onRequest hook (e.g. fastify.csrfProtection) into the /account/settings route or globally, so the route remains unprotected despite the explanation's incorrect claim that registration alone intercepts requests.

R729.note: Standard %s placeholder with raw() params list; clean fix.

R730.note: Copy is correctly bounded to 32 bytes, but frame.length is still set to the full (unclamped) dataLen before truncation, so for dataLen>32 the returned Frame reports a length longer than what was actually written to payload - a silent, undisclosed violation of the stated frame.length-matches-bytes-written contract that risks a downstream OOB read.

R731.note: Adds secure and samesite flags to the cookie; straightforward, no other change.

R732.note: Allowlist switch only accepts Id/Name/Status, but the controller's actual default is Sort="created_at" - every default (no explicit ?sort=) request now throws ArgumentException instead of using the required default sort, undisclosed.

R733.note: Eliminates the shell entirely via NIO directory listing, closing injection, but introduces a hardcoded /home/user/documents base-directory restriction with no equivalent in the original (which had no path restriction at all); disclosed in the fix but not verified against real requirements.

R734.note: Replaces hand-built RESP command over a raw socket with StackExchange.Redis's parameterized StringSet, closing CRLF command injection; the DI/API swap is stated plainly and is the correct shape for this sink.

R735.note: realpath/resolve plus prefix-with-separator (or relative_to) check closes traversal cleanly.

R736.note: For gorilla/sessions CookieStore, store.New() decodes the existing request cookie exactly like store.Get() and sets IsNew=false on successful decode - it does not discard an attacker-planted cookie. The fix is a no-op against the actual reported weakness (documented gorilla/sessions behavior).

R737.note: AesGcm with random nonce and tag replaces deterministic ECB; nonce/tag framing is disclosed and necessary.

R738.note: Moves delete to POST+doubleCsrfProtection but removes the GET route entirely with no replacement, silently breaking the 'convenience link for the delete-my-account confirmation email button' the source comments describe - unlike the equivalent Go case, no confirmation page is provided and the break is not mentioned.

R739.note: Extension now derives from the allowlisted detected MIME type via a fixed map, not the client filename; matches the case's own stated guidance.

R740.note: GetFullPath+GetRelativePath with explicit IsPathRooted check correctly catches both relative traversal and absolute/rooted path bypasses.
